verdict.rationale: Docusign documents 'configurable workflows' for agreements, conditional logic in web forms, and an MCP connector that can 'trigger workflow actions through IAM tools,' suggesting some event-driven automation capability accessible to AI agents. However there's no explicit documentation of a rule-definition engine (e.g., webhooks/Docusign Connect, if-this-then-that style triggers) that an AI-native user could configure themselves, and no independent evidence confirming this works reliably. Missing for 10: explicit rule/trigger configuration docs (e.g., event-based webhook system), independent corroboration of automated action triggers, and detail on how an AI agent defines these rules end-to-end.
